details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:972-977 (also cited as 1009-1012) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics does `return 0` on the first non-Actions run id (`reason=non_actions_check`), so eligible cancelled/timed_out Actions runs in the same blocker set are never rerun.
  WHY: The feature exists to rerun cancelled/timed_out Actions runs, and a mixed blocker set skips that. Severity disagreement: sonnet rated NIT (confidence 2) and called the behaviour deliberate, asserted by test_self_run_and_non_actions_check_are_skipped. Highest severity is used (MAJOR from minimax, luna and glm, mapped to high).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29965-29974 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last autofix run edited scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, which is outside the plan's files_touched grant, by adding `:-` defaults to five expansions that change no behavior.
  WHY: The out-of-grant edit risks failures in scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py and an ai:scope-blocked latch. Confidence 3 from glm and 4 from minimax. The severity is MAJOR from three reviewers; sonnet noted the file is not in PR CHANGED FILES and reported no defect.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1025-1041 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The rerun request is sent before its dedup marker is posted, so a marker-post failure only logs a warning and leaves no durable marker.
  WHY: A later judge invocation requests another rerun for the same head and run, violating one-rerun-per-head-and-run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4860-4913,5155-5166 (also scripts/review_rb_judge.sh rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics_enabled and scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Neither the rb_judge step nor the post-comment step passes RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED through `env:`, so the repository-variable off switch has no effect.
  WHY: An unset variable means on, so the feature cannot be disabled in the shipped workflow.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:262-267 (_pr_checks_blocking_detail, `_run_id` extraction) | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A run id is taken from any blocking check-run's details_url without checking that it belongs to this repository (hardening suggestion).
  WHY: A foreign id gets a 404 on rerun, logs `rerun_failed`, and may burn the per-head marker. Hardening risk score 1.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Gate the new paths behind RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED, default true; `false` turns it off.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (rb_judge step env and post-review-blocked comment step env)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The scripts implement the flag, but the workflow never exports the variable, no workflow file is in the diff, and the agents.d fragment says "No repository variable wires it yet". Severity disagreement: gemini rated MAJOR, the others NIT.
- requirement: List the names of the blocking checks in the comment ("list the names").
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (settled-check output assembly); scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh (settled-check list)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Both lists are capped at 20 entries with no truncation indication. Sonnet did not count this as a gap (confidence 1), and the other reviewers rated it NIT.
- requirement: The plan grant restricts files_touched to the issue's listed scripts, tests, changelog.d and agents.d paths.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 29965-29974 in last_run_diff.patch)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The file is outside the grant, and the hunk is a no-op rewrite of expansions that are already guarded.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics, the run-id loop that does `return 0` on `reason=non_actions_check` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A non-Actions check (`none:<conclusion>`) makes the function return, so no rerun is requested for the Actions runs in the same batch. This is deliberate and asserted by test_self_run_and_non_actions_check_are_skipped.
  WHY: It does not fail; it is a judgment call, and the issue text does not say which behaviour is wanted.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics_enabled) and scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh: the RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED reads | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Neither the rb_judge step nor the comment step passes the switch through `env:`, and a grep of `.github/workflows` finds no reference to the variable.
  WHY: The switch is always unset in the shipped workflow, which means on. The agents.d fragment discloses this.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Gate the new paths behind RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED, default true. | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the env of the rb_judge step and the post-review-blocked comment step.
  Evidence of absence: The scripts implement the flag semantics correctly and the tests cover them, but the workflow does not export the variable and is outside the plan grant.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: List the blocking check names in the comment. | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh and scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh.
  Evidence of absence: Both cap the list at 20 entries without saying so. The reviewer does not count it as a gap.
- Note on scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: the file is not in PR CHANGED FILES, and the five `:-` additions leave the expansions' values unchanged. No runtime defect and no scope violation reported.
- HARDENING: scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, _pr_checks_blocking_detail, the `_run_id` extraction for `PR_CHECKS_LAST_BLOCKING_RUN_IDS` | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: A foreign-repo run id would 404 on rerun and only log `rerun_failed`.
  WHY: Suggested fix: emit the run id only when `details_url` contains `/<owner>/<repo>/actions/runs/` (about 2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1009-1012 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The rerun-request loop returns early on a non-Actions check, so later eligible reruns in the same blocking set are skipped.
  WHY: When a non-Actions or "none" check triggers the early `return 0`, the Actions rerun request is never made.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:29965-29974 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The script was edited outside the approved plan's `files_touched` grant.
  WHY: This violates scope constraints and risks scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py failures in CI.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Gate the new paths behind RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED, default true. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (rb_judge step env and post review-blocked comment step env)
  Evidence of absence: The workflow file was not modified to pass the variable through, so the judge script always runs with the default "on" behavior.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "list the names." | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (settled-check output assembly); scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh (settled-check list)
  Evidence of absence: The judge appends names only while the count is at most 20, and the comment loop stops after 20 entries, so the rest are omitted without a truncation indication.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:972-977 (rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics, the while-loop over PR_CHECKS_LAST_BLOCKING_RUN_IDS that builds rb_sc_ids) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The non-Actions filter ends the whole function on the first non-numeric run id, so with mixed Actions and `none:` entries a valid cancelled/timed-out Actions run is never rerun.
  WHY: With "none:timed_out\n4711:cancelled", 4711 is never seen. test_self_run_and_non_actions_check_are_skipped (tests/test_review_rb_judge_settled_check_diagnostics.py:237) asserts no rerun for this mixed input, which masks the bug. The fix is to replace `return 0` with `continue` and update the test.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: The plan grant for #10137 restricts files_touched to the listed scripts, tests, changelog.d and agents.d paths. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 29965-29974 in last_run_diff.patch)
  Evidence of absence: The previous autofix run added `:-` defaults on `${_std_prefetched_impl_pr_num}`, `${_std_prefetched_impl_pr_json}` and `${_std_prefetched_impl_pr_miss_reason}`. This is a no-op, outside the grant, and fixes no review finding. The minimal safe action is to revert that hunk.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:972-977 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The loop returns from the diagnostics function on the first non-Actions run ID, even after collecting eligible Actions run IDs.
  WHY: With both an Actions run and a `none:<conclusion>` check in an all-cancelled/timed-out set, the function exits before the rerun loop.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1025-1041 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rerun request is sent before its dedup marker is posted. If the marker post fails, the code only logs a warning.
  WHY: A later judge invocation requests another rerun for the same head and run, violating one-rerun-per-head-and-run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4860-4913,5155-5166 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Neither step passes RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED into the script environment, and repository variables are not auto-exported.
  WHY: Setting the repository variable to `false` does not disable the behavior, so the automatic rerun path stays enabled.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Gate the new paths behind RB_JUDGE_SETTLED_CHECK_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED" and allow `false` to turn them off. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, the `rb_judge` and post-comment step environment mappings.
  Evidence of absence: The scripts read the variable but the workflow steps do not map or pass it, so the off switch is ineffective in the shipped workflow.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Set and report each blocking required check's `name:conclusion`. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  Expected change site: `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` settled-check output assembly and `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_review_blocked_comment.sh` settled-check listing.
  Evidence of absence: The judge includes at most 20 names and the comment loop stops after 20, with no truncation indication.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=0
